issues.summary: Hardcoded '108 Mum' and static time window in server.py
issues.detail: server.py had hardcoded values {'bars': 108, 'window': '2026-09-24T06:00:00Z to 14:55:00Z'} in get_engine_state(), preventing real live bar counts from appearing.

issues.summary: No live background worker executed inside Docker container
issues.detail: The container entrypoint only ran 'python -m coin_behavior_engine.web.server'. There was no background process fetching live 5m candles and generating prospective predictions.
The dashboard used a full browser reload every 15 seconds, creating screen flickering, high DOM rebuild overhead, and unnecessary HTTP request floods.
lockbox_manifest.json lacked the key 'lockbox_manifest_hash', and the dashboard template did not bind the latest hash chain entry from the prediction store.
The web server attempted to scan directories directly rather than reading an isolated, atomic < 1 KB state file updated by the worker.

issues.summary: Test suite had external dependency on psutil in memory check
issues.detail: test_42 in test_pre_24h_audit.py attempted to import psutil which is not a required dependency in minimal environments.
